name: loan-statement
title: Loan statement
for_each: select id,code from loans where status in ('settled','default','discharged') order by code

sections.title: Transactions
sections.sql: select posted_on,kind,case when kind='payment' then -amount_cents else amount_cents end amount_cents,sum(case when kind='payment' then -amount_cents else amount_cents end) over (order by posted_on,created_at,id) balance_cents,note from ledger where loan_id=$1 order by posted_on,created_at,id
sections.note: Interest is charged on an actual/365 basis.

name: arrears-letter
title: Overdue payment
for_each: select l.id,l.code from v_loans l where l.arrears_cents>0 and l.status in ('settled','default') order by l.code

sections.title: Amount overdue
sections.sql: select code loan,borrower,arrears_cents,oldest_unpaid_on,days_in_arrears,last_payment_on,manager from v_loans where id=$1
sections.note: Please pay the overdue amount or contact your loan manager this week to agree a date. Internal draft: not a formal demand or default notice.

sections.title: Unpaid charges
sections.sql: select posted_on,kind,amount_cents,note from ledger where loan_id=$1 and kind in ('interest','fee') and posted_on>=(select oldest_unpaid_on from v_loans where id=$1) order by posted_on

name: investor-statement
title: Investor statement
for_each: select i.id,i.code from investors i where exists (select 1 from allocations a where a.investor_id=i.id) order by i.code

sections.title: Investor
sections.sql: select code,name,investor_type,certificate_on from investors where id=$1

sections.title: Allocations and last calendar month's interest
sections.sql: select a.code,l.code loan,l.borrower,l.status,a.amount_cents,a.investor_rate_bps,round(a.amount_cents*a.investor_rate_bps/10000.0*(date_trunc('month',current_date)::date-greatest(a.allocated_on,(date_trunc('month',current_date)-interval '1 month')::date))/365)::bigint interest_cents from allocations a join v_loans l on l.id=a.loan_id where a.investor_id=$1 order by a.code
sections.note: Interest at the agreed investor rate, actual/365, for last calendar month. Loans in arrears or default need a decision before distribution.

name: credit-summary
title: Credit summary
for_each: select id,code from loans where status in ('application','approved') order by code

sections.title: Security
sections.sql: select code,address,security_type,market_value_cents,complete_value_cents,valued_on,valuer,valuer_independent from securities where loan_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Conditions
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,met_on from conditions where loan_id=$1 order by due_on
